title: Robot Pose
description: The robot's last known pose in its map frame.

robot_id.description: Unique lowercase DNS label identifier for the robot.

stamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

x.description: X coordinate in meters, rounded to 3 decimal places.

y.description: Y coordinate in meters, rounded to 3 decimal places.

yaw.description: Heading in radians in the map frame, rounded to 4 decimal places.

site.description: Site name this pose is valid within.

floor.description: Floor name this pose is valid within.
